channel.title: Kazakhstan passport: visa rule changes
channel.description: Destinations whose entry rule changed for Kazakhstan passport holders, found by the daily comparison of public visa-policy sources (mainly Wikipedia). Check the official source before you travel.

item.title: Montenegro: Visa-free → Visa required
item.description: Montenegro: visa-free before, visa required now, for Kazakhstan passport holders. Seen in the daily data check on 4 October 2026.

item.title: Egypt: eVisa → Visa required
item.description: Egypt: eVisa before, visa required now, for Kazakhstan passport holders. Seen in the daily data check on 4 October 2026.

item.title: Indonesia: Visa on arrival → Visa-free
item.description: Indonesia: visa on arrival before, visa-free now, for Kazakhstan passport holders. Seen in the daily data check on 15 July 2026.
